propositions: An optional isolated adapter must mine Claude Code session transcripts to reconstruct local environment and integration failure history using error-signature grep and deterministic keyword/regex classification.

The adapter must classify matched error signatures into exactly five enumerated categories (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none) and emit JSON records tagged with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified.
The core metrics package (registry.py, __init__.py) must not import the claude_transcripts adapter to maintain portability; the adapter is imported only by the backfill script.

The backfill script must deterministically extract candidate transcript lines matching known error patterns (ModuleNotFoundError, ConnectionError, timed out, HTTP 429/5xx, git/ruff/mypy/pytest failures, etc.) without invoking an LLM or network call.

Unit tests must verify that fixture JSONL transcripts with known env-failure signatures produce classified intervals with the correct enum value and metadata labels, and clean transcripts yield zero results.
The classification enum values and output JSON schema must be defined in the adapter module and coverage must include both the adapter and the backfill script entrypoint.
